text:
Alex: quick idea — add a per-route `privacy_level` knob that can automatically change sampling/redaction when a route hits quota pressure. tradeoff: keep enough telemetry to detect regressions but reduce PII exposure and token cost. :thinking:
Maya: can you sketch concrete levels and how they'd behave? short bullets please.
Alex: sure. 3 levels: 
- minimal: drop request/response bodies from telemetry, only keep hashed provenance + headers
- standard: keep request metadata + truncated responses (first 128 chars) with strong redaction heuristics
- strict: redact all free-text, keep only schema fields and length metrics
Example config snippet: ```json
{"route": "/v1/generate", "privacy_level": "standard", "quota_degrade": {"enabled": true, "threshold_pct": 85}}
```
Ibrahim: how does this interact with existing sampler + inspect/unmask flow? e.g., ops breakglass needs to be able to inspect full text for a short TTL when legally allowed. also we need to avoid changing behavior mid-request if sampling decision already made.
Alex: good points. decisions: 1) sampling/redaction decision computed at ingress before routing. 2) breakglass flows require explicit audit log and 1h TTL, and are always recorded as an action on the tenant. 3) if quota_degrade flips during a request, we don't retroactively change that request — only new ones.
Priya: console UX: show a per-route badge when quota_degrade is active + a small delta card: token cost change (7d) and quality regressions (eval pass rate). add an "explain" modal that lists why a route entered minimal/strict. make it easy to pin a route to ignore degrade for critical tenants.
Maya: embeddings/attachments special-case: we should NOT keep unredacted attachments even in minimal mode. for embeddings we should hash/nonce the raw text and only store vector + hashed id. otherwise leakage risk is high.
Ibrahim: metrics to track in canary: `route.privacy_level`, `sampled_tokens`, `redacted_hits`, `inspect_unmask_count`, `eval_prompt_set:pass_rate`, `latency_p50/p95`. also emit event `privacy_level_change` with reason (quota, tenant-override, admin).
Priya: rollout proposal: gated FF for 10% tenant sample, opt-in beta in console for selected tenants, then expand once eval pass rates stable for 24h across eval prompt sets. add a console toggle to force 'strict' per-tenant.
Alex: failure modes: 1) quality regressions not detected because we sampled too little — mitigate by reserving a tiny fixed sample (0.1%) even in minimal mode for evals. 2) auditability gap — mitigate by storing provenance hashes + request fingerprint.
ops-bot: reminder — any change to telemetry schema must have migration plan + data-contract PR. tag @eng-ml for eval prompt ownership.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: privacy-level feature-flag backend v2 -> staging at 2026-03-22T03:30Z. Canary target: 10% tenants.
Maya: small UX ask: console explanation text should surface exact fields removed so SREs can triage (e.g., body_removed: true, attachments_removed: true, response_truncated: 128).
Ibrahim: agree. also include a debug-only sample endpoint that returns a safe-scrubbed copy (with hashed tokens) for ops when they have breakglass. TTL + audit required.
Priya: I'll draft console mockups: badge + modal + tenant pin flow. also include a quick tooltip about the reserved eval sample.
Alex: action items: Maya -> update redaction heuristics doc + embedding guidance; Ibrahim -> telemetry events and canary dashboards; Priya -> console mockups and tooltip copy. I'll open the FF + rollout plan RFC.
Maya: noted. I'll start a doc and link to eval prompt IDs.
Ibrahim: creating dashboards now, will share links in thread.
Priya: mockups incoming by EOD tomorrow.
Alex: thanks team. :thumbsup: we'll monitor `eval_prompt_set:pass_rate` and `redacted_hits` during canary, and revert degrade if pass_rate drops >3% vs baseline within 6h.
Maya: one more: legal asked we log an event when a route enters strict for compliance audits — can we add `privacy_level_audit` event?
Alex: yes — include `actor`, `reason`, `previous_level`, `new_level`, `tenant_id` in the event (no PII).
ops-bot: noted. file an infra ticket for retention policy review for privacy_level events.
